title: SMC (k) in a Disability Compensation Decision Past-Due
content:
The SMC (k) additions in a Disability Compensation decision past-due are one SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) grant, up to the SMC (k) maximum, for every standing month when the whole months from the latest grant's effective date to the issue date of the most recent monthly payment, less one for each payment that came back and has no replacement, are at least the standing months; for that many months alone when they are fewer; and nothing when the decision history shows no SMC (k) grant.

The SMC (k) grants are the rating decisions recording an SMC (k) grant; the latest grant is the most recent of them. Each SMC (k) addition is 139.87, and no more than 3 are counted.

**Cases (hypothetical, 5 standing months, most recent monthly payment issued 1 June 2026, no open returns)**

| SMC (k) grants on record | Latest grant effective | Whole months to 1 June 2026 | SMC (k) amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15 November 2025 | 6 (at least 5) | 139.87 for 5 months, 699.35 |
| 1 | 15 March 2026 | 2 (fewer than 5) | 139.87 for 2 months, 279.74 |
| 4 | 15 November 2025 | 6 | 3 additions, 419.61, for 5 months, 2098.05 |
| None | — | — | Nothing |
